note: Adapted from the entry of Chhotani (1997) (147 Microcerotermes ganeshi Bose, Fig. 81; basionym Bose 1984), originally in English; synonymy, figure numbers and distribution records are not translated. The original records the alate as “Unknown”, so that caste is absent; the parenthetical “holotype examined” in the soldier and worker sections is as recorded in the original. The original gives the major-worker head width as “0.76-078”, evidently a character dropped in the OCR, and it is translated here as 0.76–0.78 mm; the postmental constriction index is given in the original as “0.47-0.525”.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: (Holotype examined.) Head capsule golden yellow, deep reddish brown anteriorly; antennae pale yellow; labrum dark golden brown; mandibles and clypeus deep reddish brown; thorax, legs and body milky yellow. Head and body sparsely setose. Total length 3.50–4.25 mm. Head capsule subrectangular, longer than wide, the sides diverging anteriorly (length to mandibular base 1.20–1.23 mm, width 0.73–0.78 mm, width/length index 0.60–0.63); in profile the frons is inclined at about 45°, the dorsum of the head slightly incurved behind the frons. Fontanelle small, circular, situated at about 1/4 of the head length from the front. Antennae 13-segmented, segment 3 shortest. Postclypeus indistinctly delimited from the frons, semicircular, with 2 pairs of long setae anteriorly; anteclypeus hyaline, trapezoidal, without setae. Mandibles coarsely serrate, the apices weakly incurved, the serrations extending almost to the apex; mandibles slightly longer than half the head length (length 0.68–0.70 mm, mandible length/head length index 0.56–0.57). Labrum lingulate, narrowed anteriorly, slightly wider than long, with a few setae on the anterior margin and on the disc (length 0.15–0.18 mm, width 0.18–0.20 mm). Postmentum rod-shaped, waist below midlength (length 0.70–0.80 mm, maximum width 0.28 mm, waist width 0.13–0.15 mm, postmental constriction index 0.47–0.525). Pronotum saddle-shaped (length 0.25–0.28 mm, width 0.45–0.50 mm); anterior margin with a distinct median notch, posterior margin nearly straight.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Dimorphic. Major worker: head capsule pale golden yellow; thorax and legs milky white; abdomen greyish white. Total length 3.30–3.60 mm. Head capsule subquadrate (length to mandibular base 0.76–0.85 mm, maximum width 0.76–0.78 mm). Antennae 13-segmented, segment 3 shortest. Postclypeus setose, arched, semicircular; longer than half its width. Pronotum small, saddle-shaped (length 0.20–0.21 mm, width 0.43–0.45 mm). Minor worker: similar to the major worker but smaller overall. Total length 3.10–3.20 mm; head length to mandibular base 0.58–0.63 mm, head width 0.62–0.68 mm; pronotal length 0.20 mm, width 0.40 mm.
